We are proud to be endorsing Anthony Bonna for the open Florida State House District 85, a Port St. Lucie based seat. Anthony’s record of service speaks for itself. In 2018, he was appointed to the St. Lucie County Commission, and later went on to serve as a City Councilman for Port St. Lucie. Under his leadership, the city achieved a 10% reduction in taxes in just 3 years, all while continuing its rapid growth as Florida’s 6th largest city. Beyond his local leadership, Anthony has been a strong voice within the Florida GOP. He currently serves as Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida’s State Committeeman and Committeewoman Caucus, where he continues to advocate for conservative values. Anthony will put FLORIDA FIRST and AMERICA FIRST! Anthony Bonna has our complete and total endorsement!
